title: Agenzia ICE porta le startup italiane al Web Summit Lisbona 2026
what_it_says: Says ICE organises Italy's collective participation in Web Summit 2026 in Lisbon, 9 to 12 November 2026, for about 30 Italian startups and innovative SMEs in the Italian national pavilion; applications open 11 May to 8 June 2026.
